problem.statement: Current WP507 can declare CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED_AT_CONTRACT_SCOPE when intervention and control share probe_id and nonbroadcast_input_sha256 but differ in an execution/model/config/environment context that is not represented in CausalProbeArm. A downstream-output difference can therefore be attributed to the broadcast intervention even though an unbound execution-context difference is an alternative explanation.

candidate.name: ProbeExecutionContext
candidate.role: Typed immutable matched-experiment witness whose canonical digest commits to the non-intervention execution conditions that must be equal between WP507 intervention and control arms.
canonical_rules: All fields are deterministic canonical-JSON inputs to context.sha256().
The broadcast intervention identity is excluded from the shared context digest because it is the declared manipulated dimension.
CausalProbeArm factories consume a concrete ProbeExecutionContext and serialize execution_context_sha256; do not accept an arbitrary naked digest as the only construction input.
Intervention and control must bind the same execution_context_sha256 for matched-control classification. A mismatch returns UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL.
WP510 revalidates the existing WP507 arm/context binding rather than defining a duplicate context schema.
The witness proves only equality of declared context fields; it does not establish hidden-state causality, world truth, semantic uptake, runtime success, effect authority or completion.

why_this_candidate.opaque_digest_candidate: Rejected at E4 because it adds only a caller-controlled equality token without defining/verifying the digest preimage semantics.
why_this_candidate.typed_shared_context_candidate: Preferred because it rejects the reproduced confound while making the digest meaning deterministic and replayable without adding model calls or a heavyweight framework dependency.
why_this_candidate.full_inspect_import: Rejected as disproportionate. The pinned Inspect distribution has a broad general evaluation dependency surface; F2 needs only the run-manifest identity pattern.

implementation_hypothesis.new_or_refactored_surface: Prefer one small F2-native typed object near gwt_uptake/evidence admission; exact file placement is Trigger-4 design authority after inspecting current source.
wp507_changes: Introduce/reuse concrete ProbeExecutionContext with canonical validation and digest.
CausalProbeArm gains execution_context_sha256 and its intervention/control factories require the concrete context object.
evaluate_causal_influence returns UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL when arm context digests differ.
Preserve existing probe_id, nonbroadcast-input, broadcast and downstream-output checks exactly.
wp510_changes: Revalidate the WP507 context-bound arm/result chain without duplicating the context definition.
Preserve generation-3 NOT_COMPUTED positive-seal fence and all existing typed downstream/re-entry lineage checks.

acceptance_tests: Negative regression: same probe_id and nonbroadcast input but different typed execution contexts must yield UNKNOWN_UNMATCHED_CONTROL even when downstream output digests differ.
Preservation: same typed execution context with different downstream output digest preserves the current contract-scope causal result when all existing prerequisites hold.
Preservation: same typed execution context with same downstream output digest remains NO_CAUSAL_INFLUENCE_OBSERVED.
Wrong/stale context generation or digest fails closed.
Nominal/fake object cannot satisfy factories if exact concrete-type/factory validation is the current local ABI pattern.
Broadcast identity must not be part of the shared context digest; the intervention/control difference remains explicit in CausalProbeArm.condition/broadcast fields.
Existing WP507 suite passes unchanged or with successor-compatible expected schema update.
Existing WP510 G3 suite including NOT_COMPUTED regression passes.
WP510 must reject any causal result whose source arms/context binding cannot be revalidated exactly.
trigger4_measurements_required: serialized/persisted bytes added per matched probe pair and reuse behavior
context construction/hash validation p50/p95/p99 on admitted build/test surface
I/O/storage delta if context objects are persisted
model-call and token delta, expected exactly zero
source/test/CI identity and exact acceptance scope
counterhypotheses: A higher-level canonical execution manifest may already bind all required fields and could be reused instead of adding a new object; Trigger 4 should search exact current source before implementation.
Some suggested fields may be irrelevant for a deterministic non-model probe and should be omitted when they do not vary or cannot confound the experiment.
Attempt/epoch identity may need to be represented as policy identity rather than concrete attempt number if repeated trials are intentionally aggregated.
If model stochasticity is material, equal configuration does not make outputs deterministic; the candidate controls known configuration confounds but does not eliminate stochastic variance.
falsifiers: Find an already-mandatory typed execution-context object whose canonical digest is consumed and compared by both WP507 probe arms; if present, retire this candidate as duplicate and wire the existing object instead.
Show under an equivalent deterministic regression that context mismatch cannot reach current WP507 contract-scope causal status; if so, the E3 reproduction assumption was incomplete.
Show that the candidate's matched-context fields necessarily include the intervention dimension, making equality impossible without erasing the experiment; if so, redesign the field boundary.

handoff.e6_requirement: Only Trigger 4 implementation plus exact admitted test/runtime evidence may promote to E6/F2 accepted scope.
